_meta.one_fact_one_home: This table generalizes the pre-write-checklist pattern from information-discrete-math's contaminated-concept table (mathematics-specific) to glosa's own domain (knowledge-legitimacy phrasing). Pattern only — no private text copied.
source: information-discrete-math skill (pattern: phrase -> smuggled non-readout -> disciplined replacement), re-derived for RWI's own domain
design/FOUNDATION_v0.5.md §5 (D-NO-VERTICAL-AUTHORITY, D-COMPARISON) and Appendix A (NC-03, NC-13, NC-31, NC-60)
_meta.how_to_use: Before writing a claim, a review_report, or a public-facing sentence: grep the draft for the `phrase` column. If found, replace with the `disciplined_replacement` and cite the `enforced_by` field/gate it now routes through.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: That agreement among a group of people is itself evidence the claim is true — silently promotes headcount to a truth oracle.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: State who agrees, on what basis, at what independence level (I0-I5), and whether their agreement was reached independently or by shared exposure to the same source.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Skips stating any warrant at all — presents a claim as needing no evidence because the author finds it self-evident.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Name the actual evidence relation and its tier, or mark the claim Dr/Open if no warrant is on file.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Substitutes a vague appeal to shared background belief for a checkable citation.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Cite the specific source(s) this is well known from, with citation_card.status, or drop the phrase.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Collapses the tier ladder — implies Th_coqc-grade machine-checked certainty regardless of what was actually done.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Name the actual tier (Th_coqc / finite_diagnostic / fit_calibrated / Dr / definition) that was actually reached.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Imports institutional/credentialed authority as if it were an epistemic lever, and hides which independence level (if any) the validation reached.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Name who reviewed it, in what role (maker/checker/approver), at what independence_class — or state that no such review has occurred.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Treats institutional acceptance as a truth oracle rather than a channel-opener; conflates legitimacy with truth.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: State that peer review is a legitimacy/channel fact (D-NO-VERTICAL-AUTHORITY) and separately state the claim's own tier and independence class.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Frames the work as a priority/originality contest instead of describing what it actually does — forbidden word (§ binding rules).
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Describe the mechanism and cite neighbours as same/different/cited (never a novelty claim).

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Asserts historical priority, which is rarely checkable and is a forbidden framing in this repo regardless of accuracy.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: State only what the artifact does and how it compares (same/different/cited) — never a priority claim.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Implies an uncontested, maximal-tier benchmark exists and this claim meets or was measured against it, without naming the actual comparator or its own tier.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Name the specific comparator, its tier, and the measurement that was actually run.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Smuggles institutional/professional-consensus authority as settled fact without naming who set the practice or on what evidence.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Name the source of the practice recommendation and its own tier/independence class, or state it is the author's own judgment (Dr).

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: Collapses an entire research programme's open questions into a single closed verdict.
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Name the specific claim, its tier, and its own non_claims — a programme is never one tier.

contaminated_concepts.what_it_smuggles: A category/conclusion locked in before the evidence-gathering step that would normally precede it, then never revisited against a changed context -- both signals together, not either alone. Narrowly scoped so it is never merged with the unrelated clinical term 'premature closure' (a different diagnostic-reasoning concept from a different domain; same-shaped name, different mechanism -- comparison: different, not same).
contaminated_concepts.disciplined_replacement: Name the two conjuncts separately: closure-timing (was the category locked before the evidence step completed?) and absence-of-adaptation (was it ever revisited against a changed context?). Only when BOTH hold jointly is this PCS (rule24, ERROR); either alone is logged as rule24w (WARNING), never flagged as PCS.
contaminated_concepts._note: Distinct entry from 'settled science' above -- PCS is the joint-condition mechanism (timing + non-adaptation) that produces a premature settlement; 'settled science' is the resulting rhetorical phrase. Not merged, per one-fact-one-home (two different rows, two different enforcement mechanisms: claim_card.tier/non_claims vs kernel rule24).
